study type: Cross-sectional survey with spatial and multilevel analysis
exposure: Breastfeeding initiation time (within the first 1h, 1-24h, or after a day)
cohort: The study included all living children born 0-23 months before the 2019 Ethiopian mini demographic and health survey and their mothers.
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding practice in Ethiopia was 56.05%, showed significant spatial variation across regions, and was lower among children born via caesarean delivery, those with late breastfeeding initiation, and mothers residing in pastoralist regions or city administrations.
mod_finding: Children born through caesarean delivery had significantly lower odds of exclusive breastfeeding practice (AOR = 0.36; 95% CI: 0.21, 0.63).
